subject: Probe splitting exploaterad mark into buildings and roads
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-14 for a small study of whether bebyggelse (unified 9, NMD2023 51/52/53) can be split into buildings and roads. Decisions [user-stated 2026-11-14]: three classes, byggnad (51), ovrig exploaterad mark (52), vag/jarnvag (53); no 3x3 erosion (all coded pixels, mixed pixels included); representations raw TESSERA and the frozen b28 model (main, 29 classes); the whole study in one sweep after a server dry-run. Pre-register scheme exploaterad3 in scripts/forest_separability_schemes.py and the class-separability README before any result, make the interior-only sampling a per-scheme setting (forest schemes keep it), then run the bounded CPU probe (2 CPU, 4 GiB, no GPU, <= 30 min) for TESSERA 2022 against NMD2023 with scripts/run_forest_separability.sh and record location-free aggregates. Not in scope: changing the class schema, labels or any training; other feature years; Prithvi features. Review: fresh Claude reviewer; integration is Tobias's decision.
